name: Below Deck Down Under
description: Set against the stunning backdrop of the tropical Whitsunday Islands and world-famous Great Barrier Reef in northeastern Australia, this series explores the complex, often explosive dynamics of the crew and a rotating group of demanding charter guests on M/Y Thalassa.

videos.title: G'Day Mate!
videos.overview: Captain Jason Chambers introduces a world of underwater adventure to charter guests along the world-famous Great Barrier Reef in Australia; while first-time bosun Jamie faces some initial challenges, new chief stew Aesha clashes with an ornery chef.

videos.title: Unchained and Untamed
videos.overview: Aesha and Ryan's opposing views on service are tested during an explosive lunch; Brittini stands up for herself on deck, while Benny takes issue working in the anchor locker; Captain Jason introduces a most improved award that isn't well received.

videos.title: The Plunger from Down Under
videos.overview: Benny struggles to stay motivated on deck, while Jamie tries to keep his team in line; Ryan and Aesha's galley communication comes to a head when the guests aren't ready for service; the crew comes together to throw a vow renewal ceremony.

videos.title: The Pirate's Booty
videos.overview: The crew gets in hot water with Captain Jason; Magda struggles in the laundry; a pirate-themed party challenges Culver to earn his title of "Entertainment Officer," but when guests ask him to jump in the hot tub, Tumi is shocked by what she sees.

videos.title: Something's Fishy
videos.overview: The crew unravels as demanding charter guests push them to their limits. Jamie and Tumi disagree over Culver's actions. In an attempt to keep Captain Jason happy, Jamie tries to take control of his deck team.

videos.title: The Tipping Point
videos.overview: Magda surprises the guests by putting on a show. Aesha learns that being a barista isn't easy. Ryan struggles to accommodate the guests' demands. An extra tip leaves Brittini in tears.

videos.title: The Safety Dance
videos.overview: Aesha gives Magda a second chance at service; safety issues come to a head between Captain Jason and Jamie, but when Jamie doesn't agree with the captain's orders, he tries to get the deck team on his side.

videos.title: Prom Night
videos.overview: The crew hosts a prom night for the charter guests after their adventure to the Great Barrier Reef.

videos.title: Squid Games
videos.overview: Magda oversteps her boundaries with Aesha; Captain Jason's colleague charters Motor Yacht Thalassa for a bachelor party; Ryan resists the guests' food requests and must face the consequences with Captain Jason.

videos.title: Loads of Croc
videos.overview: The crew enjoys a day off on an Australian crocodile safari; captain Jason finds shocking unfinished business left on the boat; Tumi comes to Aesha's defence when Ryan and Magda talk behind her back, leaving Aesha distraught.

videos.title: Benny and the Jet Skis
videos.overview: Jamie puts Brittini on the night shift after Benny doesn't pull his weight; Aesha confronts Magda and Ryan for talking behind her back; Jamie is at his wit's end with Benny's behaviour and wants him fired.

videos.title: Yachtie or Nice?
videos.overview: Jason's investigation of the deck team presents him with a difficult decision; Magda finds herself in hot water when she gets caught on the phone again; charter guests request a holiday party that calls for Culver and Aesha to dress up.

videos.title: 99 Problems and Thalassa Ain’t One
videos.overview: Several crew members don’t take Captain Jason’s demands seriously and find out he means business.

videos.title: New Kids on the Block
videos.overview: With Thalassa in turmoil, Captain Jason tries to find his footing with his new team.

videos.title: Nice Girls Finish Last
videos.overview: The new crew finally finds its footing; Culver gets too close to a charter guest on a night out.

videos.title: Dirty Laundry
videos.overview: Captain Jason continues to notice Culver’s lack of initiative; Brittini calls out a double standard.

videos.title: Drink Like No One’s Watching
videos.overview: The Thalassa crew throws a vow ceremony for the guests; Culver breaks the captain’s big rule.

videos.title: Yes, We Cairns!
videos.overview: A new charter season gets underway in Cairns, Australia's gateway to the Great Barrier Reef; the interior and exterior departments start man-down as the crew scrambles to cater to party-hearty guests.

videos.title: Floating Circus
videos.overview: The charter guests continue to be on edge with each other; a new stew comes aboard, giving the interior relief while captivating the deck team; a crew member over-commits to the Cancana surprise kiss threatens to ruin the party.

videos.title: Ice, Ice, Maybe
videos.overview: A complicated love triangle threatens to make things awkward on deck. The CEO is back for another round of fun. The guests have an icy request, and when a deck crew member overlooks his duties, one of the guests gets a cutting surprise.

videos.title: All's Fair in Love and Downpour
videos.overview: Heavy wind and rain threaten to drown a difficult beach picnic; a stew takes liberties with her break time; the guests experience a dinner fit for a god; on a night out, romantic entanglements get knotty when a surprising new hookup happens.

videos.title: Everyone Everywhere All at Once
videos.overview: A love pentagon takes shape as crew romances heat up in multiple directions, and a personality conflict on the interior intensifies. One of the deckhands falls behind, and a dinner service for the guests goes awry when their preferences are overlooked.

videos.title: All Wrong
videos.overview: Chef Tzarina struggles to rebound after a dinner gone wrong; a stew tries to convince Aesha to switch shifts, and the crew pulls off a touching memorial celebration for the guests.

videos.title: The Turnover Day
videos.overview: The crew reels and bands together in the wake of a serious event, Capt. Jason handles not one but two difficult matters between crew members; when a person on the deck team is forced to leave the boat, the hierarchy on the exterior gets a shakeup.

videos.title: Great Sexpectations
videos.overview: The deck team gets a surprising new leader, which causes resentment to grow within the department; the interior struggles being one stew down; the chef and the chief stew get a blast from the past.

videos.title: Angel Nude Cake
videos.overview: The deck team tries to recover after a mishap with the captain; a new stew joins the crew and instantly makes waves; the chef turns one of the guests into a work of art.

videos.title: Kiss Kiss Clang Clang
videos.overview: After a surprising hookup, the chef ices people out. A family comes aboard and enjoys a meal in a remote location. The tender nearly capsizes as the crew races to free it from a disappearing island. A mistake on deck causes the boat to hit the dock.

videos.title: Anchors Astray!
videos.overview: The deck team reels after a docking debacle; the Chief Stew gets a surprise visit on a day off; a deckhand unhappily gets friend-zoned; a forbidden relationship becomes too tempting to ignore; a disastrous mistake endangers the boat.

videos.title: Find Me Some Budgie to Love
videos.overview: A deckhand's fate is up in the air after an egregious error; the 2nd Officer tries to escape a rocky romantic past; the Captain reluctantly bares all for a budgie breakfast.

videos.title: The Wheel of Misfortune
videos.overview: Captain Jason makes an unpopular decision to fire a deckhand; a Lead Deckhand joins the boat; Margot struggles with a challenge on her first attempt at service; a charter guest experiences a medical emergency.

videos.title: Tick the Box
videos.overview: The crew deals with a medical emergency onboard; Capt. Jason faces a tough decision when a crew member gets caught drinking on the job; a deckhand wants to take his relationship to the next level.

videos.title: It's Not About the Lactose
videos.overview: A relationship onboard explores new depths while another one finally breaches the surface; chaos ensues when charter guests become entangled in each other's dietary preferences; single charter guests give the deckhands a run for their money.

videos.title: The Magic Seamen
videos.overview: The guests get upset with Aesha when their bucket list Great Barrier Reef diving excursion gets denied; a familiar character returns to coach the deck team through a strip show for the guests.

videos.title: An Eruption of Volcanic Proportions
videos.overview: The crew erupts in an argument when a deckhand meddles in the stew's drama; a date goes awry when chef Tzarina reveals her true feelings.

videos.title: She's Just Not That Into You
videos.overview: Capt. Jason gets involved when chef Tzarina refuses to fulfill a guest request; Luka feels like a stew might be interested in him; the final night of the charter season leads to arguing, crying and relationships in shambles.

videos.title: Seychelles, by the Seashore
videos.overview: Capt. Jason embarks across the dazzling waters of the Seychelles with almost an entirely new crew on the larger-than-life motor yacht Katina. The enormity of the boat puts new Chief Stew Lara and her interior team to the test. Chef Tzarina and Lara are reunited after a previous working relationship and tensions quickly surface as their clashing styles ignite old frustrations. Tzarina faces an infestation of weevils in the galley while she tries to find her stride with her new sous chef, Anthony.

videos.title: Too Many Cooks
videos.overview: Chef Tzarina feels the heat as Anthony begins to chafe under her direction; a near collision while docking tests Capt. Jason's patience; Lara continues to adjust to the sprawling layout of Katina; Harry finds himself in a familiar love triangle.

videos.title: Walking on Eggshells
videos.overview: Harry makes his move with Brianna, but just as sparks begin to fly, he suffers an injury; Wihan ignites tension within the ranks when he oversteps Lara's department; things heat up in the galley as Anthony contemplates leaving his position.

videos.title: Kiss and Don't Tell
videos.overview: Anthony puts Tzarina in a bind causing her to crack under pressure; Harry's fate on Katina is determined after knowing the extent of his injury; Marina asks Wihan on a date, sparking tension between her and Tzarina.

videos.title: Submergency
videos.overview: Wihan's attention shifts to a new flame while Lara gets frustrated with his carefree attitude; an overlooked hazard causes Johnny and a charter guest to flip a jet ski in dangerously shallow waters.

videos.title: The Captain's Lounge
videos.overview: After the jet ski incident, the deck team tries to make up for it by entertaining guests in the exclusive Captain's Lounge; a new yachtie arrives and stirs things up; Bri starts to question if her spark with Harry has fizzled out.

videos.title: Declaration of Love
videos.overview: Wihan, in love, writes a heartfelt letter; Harry attempts to rekindle romance with Bri; Lara's team criticisms irritate Wihan, with silver hot pants becoming the breaking point.

videos.title: Rumble in the Jungle
videos.overview: The crew puts together "Fear Factor" inspired games for the charter guests; Tzarina and Lara confront Wihan after a messy beach excursion; the deck crew starts to question Wihan's leadership and Jason gets involved.

videos.title: Foam Sick
videos.overview: Adrenaline-junkie guests test the boundaries on Katina; Lara and Wihan's working relationship comes to a head when Capt. Jason intervenes; a disgruntled stew lets their attitude get the better of them when they get sassy with the captain.

videos.title: A Greek Tragedy
videos.overview: Tensions boil over when a crew member stirs chaos among the team; their behavior tests loyalties and patience.

videos.title: The Shots You Don’t Take
videos.overview: The aftermath of an intense evening results in a drastic crew dynamic shift; Tzarina and Lara disagree over plating, causing them to clash.

videos.title: Across Frenemy Lines
videos.overview: A deckhand is forced to own up to their mistake. Jason pushes Lara out of her managerial comfort zone. Tzarina struggles to find resolve with Lara. Alesia gets frustrated with Tzarina. The crew goes out and a new love connection is formed while a friendship starts to fall apart.

videos.title: Lipstick Service
videos.overview: Harry struggles with his new responsibilities on deck; the interior tries to keep it together in housekeeping; Tzarina attempts to take control of her department; a sudden lightning storm threatens Circus Night for the guests.

videos.title: The Circus
videos.overview: Tensions arise behind the curtain of Circus Night; in the galley, a disagreement over breakfast spirals into a heated argument, forcing Capt. Jason to get involved.

videos.title: Smoochies
videos.overview: Bri starts to worry about her relationship off the yacht; Alesia gets a sudden "ick" from baby talk; Marina puts her walls down, but worries feelings aren't reciprocated; Tzarina and Lara come to a stalemate with neither of them ready to apologize.

videos.title: Come Swell or High Water
videos.overview: Bri and Harry try to define their relationship; the crew picks up their last charter guests who can't keep their food down during a swelly charter; during the last beach excursion, the deck team commits their biggest error of the season.

videos.title: Never Can Sey' Goodbye
videos.overview: Capt. Jason reprimands the deck crew for their mistake; the final night of the charter season sparks an unlikely hook up and argument between crew members.

videos.title: The Real Housewives of Down Under
videos.overview: As Capt. Jason reunites with his all-star heads of department Chef Ben, Daisy and Joao for a high-pressure opening charter with The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City, a sudden crew emergency rattles the boat before guests even board.

videos.title: Night of the Living Dread
videos.overview: As housewives drama continues to boil over, Capt. Jason keeps his distance while mounting pressure in the galley puts Chef Ben and Alesia at odds. When mechanical failures, a last-minute service change and an over-the-top guest request push the crew to their limits, Alesia is left questioning whether she has what it takes to stay in the kitchen.

videos.title: The Boil Over
videos.overview: Capt. Jason introduces anonymous guest feedback cards and the crew celebrates a record-breaking tip. During a crew night out, personal tensions bubble to the surface when Alesia’s romantic rejection sparks fallout, and a game turns explosive between her and Chef Ben.

videos.title: The Chef's Assistant
videos.overview: A crew shakeup fuels Jenna’s jealousy and distracts Chef Ben in the kitchen. A string of missteps leaves Daisy and Capt. Jason scrambling to regain control before mounting guest complaints sink the charter.

videos.title: Textual Tension
videos.overview: Reeling from harsh guest feedback, Chef Ben overcompensates in the galley and clashes with Daisy over radio miscommunication. New crushes form on board and jealousy ignites when a scandalous text is sent among crew members.

videos.title: Gossip Boy
videos.overview: As Alesia scrambles to bury a regrettable text, gossip spreads faster than she can contain it; Chef Ben finds his footing in the galley until a broken oven threatens to derail the charter and push him back into crisis mode.

videos.title: Burnt Bridges
videos.overview: A broken oven forces Chef Ben to attempt a seven-course dinner under extreme pressure; Cracks spread across the boat as Mike goes missing when he's needed most.

videos.title: Call Me By My Name
videos.overview: A high-stakes four-day charter with a vow renewal gets off to a rocky start when Jenna’s cabin mistake puts the interior team under scrutiny. As pressure mounts in the galley, a sharp comment from Chef Ben pushes Ellie past her limits and forces Capt. Jason to step in and restore order mid-service before the charter spirals out of control.

videos.title: Till Chaos Do Us Part
videos.overview: As galley tensions boil over and guest complaints rattle Chef Ben’s confidence, Capt. Jason demands professionalism when Chef Ben and Ellie clash through a tense dinner service. Mounting interior mistakes force Daisy to draw a hard line with her team. Capt. Jason calls Chef Ben and Ellie to the bridge for a final reckoning.

videos.title: Making Enemies
videos.overview: Peace in the galley comes at a price when Chef Ben introduces a pet-name penalty to keep tensions in check. Ellie makes a bold move on Joao. Alesia stirs the pot by pulling Eddy away from Jenna.

videos.title: Soapy Eggs
videos.overview: Jenna and Eddy find their way back to each other despite Alesia's meddling. Missteps quickly pile up as Ellie makes a disastrous breakfast mistake, a surprise drag show is spoiled by loose lips.

videos.title: Dates and Confused
videos.overview: After charter guests depart with a surprise gift and a daring offer for extra tip money, Capt. Jason grants the crew a long-awaited day off, but time away only fuels the drama as Daisy reaches her breaking point with ongoing infighting.

videos.title: The Way the Cookie Crumbles
videos.overview: Chef Ben begins to feel Daisy no longer has his back and when a demanding charter guest sends him spiraling in the galley, her attempt to step in only deepens the rift between the two heads of department.

videos.title: Head of the Deck/Stew Department
videos.overview: Chef Ben and Jenna try to take their flirtations to the next level, but Eddy’s jealousy and Mike’s interference get in the way. After Mike crosses a line with Daisy, tensions explode across the boat. Crew gossip sparks a room swap. A shrimp-cocktail dispute causes Daisy and Ellie to clash.

videos.title: It's Not About the Shrimp
videos.overview: The arrival of a new stew pushes Jenna’s jealousy into overdrive. A fight between Daisy and Ellie over shrimp cocktail puts Chef Ben in the middle. After Eddy reveals a text that changes everything, Chef Ben must decide where he stands with Jenna.

videos.title: The Garden Party
videos.overview: A not-so-secret kiss puts relationships onboard under serious strain, with consequences that leave one crew member stripped of their stripes; A high-pressure dinner service takes an unexpected turn, leaving both the guests and Capt. Jason stunned.

videos.title: When Egos Collide
videos.overview: In the wake of one crew member's demotion, another pushes for a promotion; Chef Ben's plan to promote Ellie stirs tension with Daisy; A crew night out explodes into a full-blown showdown, leaving Joao caught in the middle and forced to pick a side.

videos.title: Canouan and Done
videos.overview: Capt. Jason draws a line in the sand with his HODs before the final charter; a returning charter guest proves difficult for the galley team; the crew says goodbye.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 2 nominations total
